scope: Independent standard-library byte verifier/restorer for the final staged publication manifest (JSON entries object or canonical JSONL record stream). Never access source_absolute or original source files; never decode artifact code/JSON/images/arrays. Only manifest metadata is parsed; gzip is decompressed as bytes. A physical gzip descriptor is separately checked as opaque bytes against its stored SHA/size when declared.
raw: For every PUBLISHED_RAW record, published_sha256 must equal source_sha256. Stream stored bytes and compare original SHA256 and size_bytes.
gzip: For each PUBLISHED_GZIP_CHUNKS record, stream all ordered gzip parts, checking each stored SHA256/stored size and each decoded size. Hash their concatenated decoded bytes and compare both source_sha256/content_sha256 and size_bytes/content_size_bytes. No logical-file truncation or replacement.
paths: Only manifest-relative publication paths, safe components, V112 name precheck before any open/stat. Use POSIX directory file descriptors and O_NOFOLLOW for every ancestor and file; symlink traversal is rejected.
CLI: Default action is verification only (all records when no logical path is supplied). --verify-all explicitly verifies all published originals. --logical PATH verifies one logical artifact. --logical PATH --output NEW_PATH restores only that artifact; existing output is never overwritten.
restoration: Write an exclusive new partial file under an existing safely opened output directory, verify full original SHA and size, then hard-link to the requested new name without overwrite. On failure retain the partial evidence and report failure; do not replace an existing file.
